name: English NER Test Set (Long Documents)
description: Long-form text scenarios, each over 200 words, covering cybersecurity operations and incident response

samples.text: On March 15, 2024, duty engineer Zhang Wei at the BlueShield InfoTech Center Security Operations Department discovered abnormal traffic alerts on the core switch located in the Beijing Yizhuang Datacenter. The switch IP was 10.200.1.1 with MAC AA:11:BB:22:CC:33. Investigation revealed multiple SSH login attempts from external IP 203.0.113.88 using account admin with passwords admin123 and P@ssw0rd. Zhang Wei escalated to SOC Director Li Ming at phone 13800138000 and email liming@blueshield-tech.com. Li Ming activated emergency response and notified Deputy Network Manager Liu Yang to block the source. The team audited all servers under domains oa.blueshield.local and mail.blueshield.local.

The TianShu Cybersecurity Research Institute known as TSRC published a report on industrial control system security in April 2024. Researcher Wang Fang conducted penetration testing on a manufacturing SCADA system and found PLC controllers at IP 172.16.50.10 and HMI panels at IP 172.16.50.20 in the Shanghai Songjiang Industrial Park still using default credentials operator as both username and password. The OPC server domain scada.mfg-demo.local had its management console exposed to the internet. Wang Fang reported to TSRC Technical Director Zhao Gang via email zhaogang@tsrc.org.cn and DingTalk account zhaogang_tsrc. Zhao Gang coordinated with IT Department Head Sun Li at phone 021-55667788 to disconnect affected devices and implement remediation including deploying industrial firewalls and IDS systems in the DMZ zone.

Senior Security Consultant Dr. Chen at XingHe Data Science Laboratory conducted an internal audit in May 2024 covering over 200 servers across three machine rooms at Shenzhen Nanshan Tech Park. The MySQL database cluster on IP range 10.100.1.0/24 used root account with weak password Mysql@2023. The Redis cache server at 10.100.2.15 had password redis123 while Elasticsearch nodes from 10.100.3.20 to 10.100.3.25 had no authentication at all. Dr. Chen reported via enterprise WeChat account chenbs_xinghe to Laboratory Director Zhou Lei at email zhoulei@xinghe-lab.cn and phone 18600001111. Recommendations included enforcing strong passwords for all services, deploying a bastion host for SSH and RDP access control, and migrating services to internal domains db.xinghe.local and cache.xinghe.local.

On June 10, 2024, the RuiAn Technology Group SOC detected a sophisticated APT attack. Attackers phished Marketing employee He Xin at email hexin@ruian-tech.com to obtain VPN account hexin_vpn with password Hx@2024spring. Using the VPN tunnel they accessed the corporate network and compromised the file server at 192.168.10.50 with MAC BB:CC:DD:EE:FF:00 and the mail server at 192.168.10.60 in the Guangzhou Tianhe Software Park. SOC analyst Ma Chao at phone 15912345678 and Feishu account machao_soc detected the anomaly in SIEM logs and alerted Chief Security Officer Bai Jie at email baijie@ruian-tech.com. Bai Jie activated top-level response and coordinated with IT Operations Manager Yang Fan to isolate affected segments. Senior Consultant Feng Xue from LongTeng InfoSec Services at phone 010-88889999 performed forensics revealing access attempts to erp.ruian.local and crm.ruian.local.

The Information Security Department of ChaoYang Digital Technology Group organized a company-wide cybersecurity inspection in July 2024 led by Department Director Qian Jin with QQ account 12345678 and email qianjin@chaoyang-digital.com. The inspection at the Wuhan Optics Valley R&D Center revealed multiple issues: the core router at 172.20.1.1 had SNMP community string set to default public, the wireless AP controller with MAC FF:EE:DD:CC:BB:AA used simple password wifi@admin, the DNS server dns.chaoyang.local was vulnerable to zone transfers, and FTP server ftp.chaoyang.local allowed anonymous access. IT Supervisor Han Meimei at phone 13700137000 and DingTalk hanmm_cy organized immediate remediation. Senior Network Engineer Xu Wenqiang completed all password changes, ACL updates, and WAF plus IPS deployments within two weeks before submitting the final report.
